capex_models.title: Garrett detailed factorial

source.reference: Donald E. Garrett, Chemical Engineering Economics (1989), Ch.3 Table 3-4

notes: Installation is embedded in the whole-plant direct factors, not a separate equipment installation addition (pp.29–30).
Source ranges are not separate solid/mixed/fluid factor profiles; classification informs review only.
Offsite and startup fractions use core plant cost before additional requirements; no self-referential total.

capex_models.title: Nottingham detailed factorial

source.reference: University of Nottingham CEE Design Consultants, CEEDG501 Cost Estimation Rev 3, section 3.2
source.note: Revision history says Rev 3 (7 Nov 2017); body footer still says Revision 2 / September 2017. Both retained.

notes: Published table uses rounded percentages of delivered purchase cost; approximate subtotal relationships are separately selectable.
No separate source factor for insulation/foundations/environmental/startup is invented; these require scope review, not an added Garrett percentage.
